title: palimpsest: Typography-first collation for literary texts
description:
An open-source application for comparing two witnesses of a literary text. It aligns passages before comparing words, so a moved paragraph remains a move, a paragraph split remains a split, and only genuinely revised words are marked as insertions or deletions.

Features word-level collation, moved/split/merged passage detection, synoptic and unified reading modes, verse-aware line-by-line comparison of poetry, and TEI P5 export using parallel segmentation.
